verdict: Organic engagement declining across all three locations; paid channels remain inactive.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, the last 28 days produced 382 combined Google Business Profile actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — with zero paid spend and zero paid leads on any channel. GBP engagement dropped sharply this week at every location: 55% at Forte Metals, 71% at Advance Grinding, and 39% at O'Hare Precision, and the last three to four days show near-zero or zero daily actions at all three, which confirms this is a sustained organic visibility issue rather than routine fluctuation. The root cause is being investigated now, with a site-level fix targeted for submission by August 31. Outreach contact pulls for Advance Grinding and Forte Metals are also in motion by August 31, with lapsed reengagement sequences to follow in September — these steps are designed to generate activity that does not depend on search visibility alone.
